items.prompt: A caller receives outside teaching numerical domain. What should it do?

options.text: Replace the option value by zero silently
Clamp every unsupported positive time or volatility to zero and use the limiting branch
options.why: Small positive inputs are not identical to zero; use a validated method or report the supported-domain limit.

options.text: Surface unsupported domain/use a validated method
options.why: Do not hide failed evaluation as a valid price.

items.explanation: Error semantics are part of the pricing contract.
